claims: Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for his role in One Battle After Another.

The 2026 Supporting Actor nominees were: Sean Penn (One Battle After Another) — Winner, Benicio Del Toro (One Battle After Another), Jacob Elordi (Frankenstein), Delroy Lindo (Sinners), Stellan Skarsgård (Sentimental Value).
